Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: The plan includes a basic inventory of district facilities including number of classrooms and relocatable classrooms (p.7-9), but lacks detailed site plans, square footage of classrooms, and comprehensive condition assessments of building systems.

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides comprehensive enrollment projections over five years with detailed student generation rates by housing type, capacity utilization data by school level, and explicit connection to facility needs and fee calculations (pp.9-28).

Educational Alignment.justification: No mention or discussion of educational goals, specifications, or how facilities align with instructional needs or programs in the provided plan content.

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: No references to outdoor spaces, greening, shade, or outdoor learning in the plan content.

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: No mention of climate risks, climate readiness, or mitigation strategies in the plan content.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: No mention of energy efficiency, electrification, decarbonization, or energy resilience strategies in the plan content.

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Provides detailed cost estimates for projects, funding sources including bonds and state funds, and a prioritization framework for fees and capital needs (pp.16-29). Lacks comprehensive discussion of long-term financial sustainability and alternative financing.
